_README: Copy for the home page. Everything under `terms` and `faq` is a commercial commitment — confirm each line is true of how Trajectra actually contracts before this goes live. See docs/12-rebrand.md.

hero.headline: Custom software teams for companies that need to ship.
hero.lede: Trajectra builds new products, modernises the ones you already have, and embeds senior engineers into your roadmap — working your hours, wherever you are, at a rate that makes sense.
hero.footnote: No pitch deck. We'll tell you on the call whether we're the right fit.

facts.label: Overlaps the working day in Europe, Africa, the UK and the Americas
Scope and cost agreed in writing before work starts

services.heading: Three ways to work with us
services.lede: Most engagements start as a fixed-scope build and continue as a retainer. You are never obliged to do either.

process.heading: What happens after you book the call
process.lede: No discovery theatre and no six-week sales cycle. You will know where you stand within a week.

steps.title: The call
steps.detail: You describe what you're building and what's in the way. We tell you honestly whether we're the right team for it — and point you elsewhere if we're not.

steps.title: Written proposal
steps.detail: Scope, milestones, timeline and a fixed price. One page, no obligation, and yours to take elsewhere if you want a comparison.

steps.title: Build
steps.detail: Weekly demos against working software, not status reports. Code lands in your repository from the first commit, so you can watch progress without asking for it.

steps.title: Handover
steps.detail: Documentation, runbooks and a walkthrough with your team. You can take it in-house the day we finish, or keep us on a retainer.

terms.heading: The things most agencies make you ask for
terms.lede: You are considering trusting a team you found on the internet, in another country. These are the terms that should make that easier.

items.title: You own the code
items.detail: Full IP assignment on final payment. No licence-back, no retained rights.

items.title: Your repository from day one
items.detail: We commit to your GitHub organisation, not ours. Nothing is ever held hostage.

items.title: Fixed price, agreed up front
items.detail: Scope changes go through a written change order. No open-ended hourly bills.

items.title: Thirty-day exit
items.detail: Retainers end with 30 days' notice. No annual lock-in, no penalty.

items.q: What timezone do you work in?
items.a: West Africa Time (UTC+1), and we work to your calendar rather than ours. UTC+1 is a convenient place to sit: a full working day of overlap with Europe, the UK and Africa, a wide afternoon window with the Americas, and a morning window with the Gulf and South Asia. Tell us your hours on the call and we will tell you honestly how much of them we can cover.
Yes. Trajectra Technologies is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission in Nigeria and contracts internationally. Registration details appear on every contract and invoice.

items.q: Who owns the code you write?
items.a: You do. Intellectual property is assigned to you on final payment, and we commit directly to your repository from the first day, so there is never a handover cliff.

Fixed scope and fixed price, agreed in writing before anything begins. Retainers are priced per engineer per month with a three-month minimum. We give you the number on the first call rather than publishing a range that would not fit your project.

items.q: What happens if the project goes wrong?
items.a: You keep everything built up to that point — it is already in your repository and the IP terms are unconditional. Retainers end with 30 days' notice. We would rather end an engagement early than hand over something you cannot use.
Bank transfer in USD, EUR, GBP or NGN — whichever suits you. Invoices are issued against milestones for fixed-scope projects, and monthly for retainers.

finalCta.heading: Tell us what you're building.
finalCta.lede: Thirty minutes, no obligation, and an honest answer about whether we're the right team for it.
